summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, attaching a press release reporting its 1Q2026 financial results. The release states a net result of €1,556 million, profit before tax up 6% YoY, and announces a €1.0 billion share buyback. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine earnings report without special-situation elements. There are no deal terms because no transaction is occurred.
